summary: Add Go Make Money: give Claude your real money goal, not a task ("go make money: get me to 1,000 paying members by Dec 31"). It works out the weekly pace (unknown baseline stays UNKNOWN, labelled needs real baseline), reads your raw Threadify rows (posts, tracked links, signups, offers, conversion setup) and the page your links land on, and a script builds the funnel (views, clicks, signups, paid) and names the biggest leak with the exact rows behind it. It asks why you think it happens and tests that belief against the rows (does the page match the promise; do people reach the call to action), sends only the diagnosis and the raw table to an outside judge on a different model (codex exec read-only, else a fresh Claude) with a hard time limit, lists the 3 claims a skeptical buyer would doubt with each quote checked against the page, ranks three decisions by impact on paid conversion, speed and reversibility, and ships fix #1 after one exact yes (offer + Auto Plug + tracked link, one Threadify post scheduled at the best time with the casing guard, or an optional landing-page pull request that is never merged). A goal ledger grades the fix on the same numbers next run, and a local report page shows it all with a big leak card.
